items.name: Stable Audio
items.why: 大幅提升音樂和音效生成長度至 6 分鐘 20 秒，並提供開源模型，支援更複雜的音樂結構與編輯功能。
items.why_en: Significantly extends music and sound effect generation length to 6 minutes 20 seconds, offering open-weight models and supporting more complex musical structures and editing capabilities.

items.name: ElevenLabs Music
items.why: 顯著提升歌曲的人聲、樂器和編曲品質，並支援多語言與商業授權，同時大幅降低價格。
items.why_en: Significantly improves vocal, instrumentation, and arrangement quality in music, with enhanced multilingual support, commercial licensing, and substantial price reductions.

items.name: Gemma
items.why: 首個中型模型具備原生音訊輸入能力，可在筆記型電腦上運行，實現多模態代理工作流程。
items.why_en: First mid-sized model with native audio input, capable of running on laptops to enable multimodal agentic workflows.
